subfamily: Whisky Old-Fashioned built over one large cube, sweetened with a rich plum syrup adapted from the Codex's Blended Strawberry Syrup (p. 47), as a nod to the Bluff depot
glass: heavy double old-fashioned tumbler (about 300 ml), one large cube
version: v1.1 (Tomás, round 5, 2026-10-01; drink unchanged from v1, round 4). Wren r3: the plum Old-Fashioned walks (the plum a nod to the depot, never 'the plums they found'; the syrup is prep, never the gesture; 'ripe' stays). Changes since her ruling, named to her: v0's rich 1:2 syrup (r3, after the 1:1 at 10 ml went OUT on acid at 0.070%), and now 7.5 -> 6.25 ml, because a low-melt worst case (one big cube melting 15-20%) took sugar over 8.5 g. Bottle: Shackleton blended malt (40%), recommended, named for him and built on a recreation of the whisky his expedition left under its hut (Hester A24), never the hut whisky; substitute: a Highland blended malt Scotch, 40-43%. Fresh plum is our stand-in for the depot's preserved Carlsbad plums (Hester r3). Plum is on the Matrix's Grain wheel (pdf 137, rendered), not listed among Grain's pairings (pdf 136). Plum syrup values unsourced.
